answer: Down in the cellar the rush mat maker rolls her mats round a pole, so they keep their shape till market day. Bamboo rattan chair caner pannier seal is the rolling: a seal rattan chair caners renew after caning bench hearings. The canyon is the first mat rolled, the reef the last before the pole is hung, and the ivory is the hanging, the pole swaying from the beam. Forging the rolling needs 89 false rollings and 89 false hangings.
